proof_body:
by
  intro r
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_abs_lt_one⟩
  · rintro ⟨L, hL⟩
    by_contra hcon
    have habs : 1 ≤ |r| := by
      by_contra hlt
      have := abs_lt.mp (not_le.mp hlt)
      exact hcon ⟨this.1, this.2.le⟩
    have hr1 : r ≠ 1 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hcon ⟨by norm_num, le_rfl⟩
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => r ^ (n + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds L) := (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mpr hL
    have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => r ^ (n + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds (L * r)) := by
      simpa [pow_succ] using hL.mul_const r
    have hLr := tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2
    have hL0 : L = 0 := by
      have : L * (r - 1) = 0 := by linarith
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right (sub_ne_zero.mpr hr1)
    subst hL0
    have h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => |r ^ n|) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using hL.abs
    have h4 : ∀ n : ℕ, (1 : ℝ) ≤ |r ^ n| := by
      intro n
      rw [abs_pow]
      exact one_le_pow₀ habs
    have := ge_of_tendsto' h3 h4
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    rcases h2.eq_or_lt with rfl | h2
    · exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨0, tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_abs_lt_one (abs_lt.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩)⟩
target_source: ∀ (r : ℝ), ((∃ L : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => r ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds L)) ↔ (-1 < r ∧ r ≤ 1)) ∧ (|r| < 1 → Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => r ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
